CustomField.label: Calculated EMI
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Tenure_Months__c > 0, Loan_Amount__c > 0), IF(Interest_Rate__c > 0, Loan_Amount__c * (Interest_Rate__c / 1200) * (1 + Interest_Rate__c / 1200) ^ Tenure_Months__c / ((1 + Interest_Rate__c / 1200) ^ Tenure_Months__c - 1), Loan_Amount__c / Tenure_Months__c), 0)
